what: The shared LEAD pattern, case by case. import_cleanup._NOTE_LEAD and static/note-blocks.js LEAD read a label off the front of a note's paragraph, and the two are hand-written mirrors. Each case records the label and the body the pattern must produce, or null when it must not match at all. Regenerate with scripts/gen_note_lead_cases.py.
